  • Classes in com.eqixiac.equinix.customerportal.model used by com.eqixiac.equinix.customerportal.client
    Class
    Description
    Asset
    An installed-base asset retrieved from the Equinix Customer Portal Assets v1 API: a product or piece of equipment belonging to the organization that is installed in an Equinix IBX.
    Attachment
    Metadata for a file attachment in the Equinix Customer Portal (Attachments v1 attachment).
    BetaTermsAgreement
    The current user's acceptance of the Digital LOA private beta terms (diLOA v1 API).
    BillingAccount
    A billing account, as returned by the Billing v1 finance accounts API.
    BillingAccountV2
    A billing account, as returned by the Platform Billing Account v2 (BAS) API.
    ConnectionService
    A connection service available at an IBX, with its supported media types.
    DigitalLoa
    A Digital Letter of Authorization (Digital LOA) document from the Equinix Customer Portal diLOA v1 API.
    DigitalLoaChange
    A change record applied to a Digital LOA document, from the Equinix Customer Portal diLOA v1 API.
    EmailDetails
    Full details of a single email associated with a support case, as returned by the support v1 email details endpoint (EmailDetailsResponse).
    InvoiceDetail
     
    InvoiceSummary
     
    LoaCustomerOrganization
    A customer organization the current user may use as a Digital LOA requestor (diLOA v1 API).
    LookupLocation
    A permitted IBX location for a customer, with its accounts and cages, as returned by the Customer Portal Lookup v2 colocation locations API (locations_details).
    Notification
    An IBX or network notification in the Equinix Customer Portal (Notifications v1 ibx-notification / network-notification).
    Order
    An order retrieved from the Equinix Customer Portal (Orders v2).
    OrderHistoryItem
    A single order history record (order-header) returned by an order history search.
    OrderNegotiation
    A negotiation message on an order, proposing an alternative date and time for fulfilling the order request.
    OrderResponse
    Result of submitting a colocation order, carrying the generated order identifier.
    PatchPanel
    A patch panel available for cross-connect ordering.
    PendingStorageOrderResponse
    One entry of the result of submitting a pending storage shipment order (pending-storage-order-response item in the shipments v1 spec) — the API returns one entry per stored shipment submitted, identifying the created order and the storage, location and account it applies to.
    PermissibleLocation
    A location the current user may filter order history by: an IBX and its permitted cages.
    PrivateBetaPermission
    Whether the current user is permitted to use the Digital LOA application in its private beta phase (diLOA v1 API).
    ProductAvailability
    Secure cabinet product availability for an IBX, describing the cabinet capacity and power configuration that may be ordered at a given location.
    Provider
    A provider available as the A-side of a cross-connect order.
    Quote
    A quote retrieved from the Equinix Customer Portal (Quotes v2).
    Report
    A generated report in the Report Center (Reports v1 downloadable-report for the list view, report for the detail view).
    ScheduledReport
    A scheduled report definition in the Report Center (Reports v1 scheduledReport).
    ShipmentLocation
    An IBX where the current user may place shipment orders, with the cages (and, when requested with detail=true, accounts and cabinets) the user has access to (location in the shipments v1 spec).
    ShipmentOrderResponse
    Result of submitting an inbound or outbound v1 shipment order (shipment-order-response in the shipments v1 spec).
    SmartHandResponse
    Response returned after submitting a smart hands order, carrying the generated order number.
    SmartHandsLocation
    An IBX and its cages where the current user is permitted to place smart hands orders.
    SmartHandType
    A supported smart hands order type, as returned by the reference types endpoint.
    SupportCase
    A trouble ticket / support case retrieved by case or order number from the Equinix Customer Portal support v2 API (SingleCaseResponseV2).
    SupportPlan
    A Smart Hands support plan retrieved from the Equinix Customer Portal Support Plans v2 API (GET /colocations/v2/supportPlans).
    TroubleTicket
    A trouble ticket retrieved from the Equinix Customer Portal Tickets v2 API.
    TroubleTicketOrderLocation
    An IBX and its cages where the current user is permitted to place trouble ticket orders.
    TroubleTicketType
    A trouble ticket problem category, as returned by the reference types endpoint.
    UnifiedNotification
    A unified order / colocation notification event returned by the Customer Portal unified notifications v2 search API.
    WorkVisitLocation
    An IBX where the current user may place work visit orders, with the cages (and, when requested with detail=true, accounts and cabinets) the user has access to (location in the workvisit v1 spec).
